overview.en:
Discover, compare and run AI models on Replicate through its official MCP server.

Find suitable models for a defined generation task before running one. Compare the available model information and make the input requirements explicit.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Replicate 官方 MCP 查找、比较并运行 AI 模型。

执行前为明确的生成任务查找合适模型，比较可用模型信息并说明输入要求。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find models suitable for this image or video generation task.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找适合这个图像或视频生成任务的模型。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these models and explain their required inputs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这些模型，并解释所需输入。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a model run for this brief so I can review the parameters.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这份简报准备模型运行方案，供我审阅参数。
